outcome: Angiotensin II-mediated contraction (maximal contraction percentage, pD2 values)
mRNA expression levels of angiotensin II type 1 receptor gene
cohort: Isolated umbilical arteries were obtained from normal and gestational diabetes pregnant women.
finding: The study found increased sensitivity to angiotensin II in GDM umbilical arteries compared to normal arteries, and suggested that Toll-like receptor 4 may determine the vasoconstrictive effect of angiotensin II in both normal and GDM umbilical arteries.
